title: ast.search request
description: Read-only structural search: run a Tree-Sitter query against a file (`path`) or inline `source` and return every match with every capture bound. Exactly one of `path` or `source` is required; `source` has no extension, so it requires `language`.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the source file. The grammar is inferred from its extension unless `language` is supplied. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.description: Inline source text to search instead of reading a file. Requires `language` since there is no extension to infer from. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

query.description: Tree-Sitter S-expression query. Must declare at least one capture (`@name`); search binds and returns every capture by name.

language.description: Optional grammar override (e.g. "rust", "typescript", "python"). Required when `source` is used.

max_matches.description: Cap on the number of matches returned, in document order; 0 (default) is unlimited. When the cap truncates results the response sets `truncated: true`.
